overview: IMemoryCache registration and APIs, expiration and size limits, key/version/tag invalidation, cache organization and single-flight/stampede protection.

regions.summary: Basic setup and extension methods; Get/Set/TryGetValue/GetOrCreate; absolute/sliding expiration; size limits and per-entry size; explicit removal and update invalidation.

Bulk invalidation strategies: explicit key removal, versioned keys, version counters, lightweight manual tag/index implementations, when each strategy is appropriate and caveats in multi-instance systems.

Cache stampede behavior, why GetOrCreate is convenience rather than a single-flight guarantee, per-key SemaphoreSlim/lock patterns, cleanup concerns and why distributed caches need distributed coordination.
